cases.name: Nicole Lynn Kinneer
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "She was a graduate of Connellsville High School and then received her Bachelors Degree in Psychology from California University of Pennsylvania. She continued her education at the University of Hawaii where she then received her Masters Degree in Psychology. Nicole worked as a Psychologist for Wormack Inc. in Connellsville. Nicole was a kind, loving and very artistic person. She enjoyed crocheting, gardening, and working with stained glass."
